meta.frames: the building frame (both prefabs): x east, y north, z up, origin = the ground floor's finished level at the middle of the main block (ground floor 0.0, upper floor 3.40, basement -3.00, roof 6.60, garage floor -0.15, the yard at the entrance -0.45) - the frame of Update 3's BaseMain.fbx after import
meta.unity: position (x, y, z) -> Unity prefab-local (-x, z, -y) (pivotUnity given); a hinge's Blender axis is Update 3's Unity axis as (X, Z, -Y) with angle -> -angle, a slide's (-X, -Z, Y); u3.axisUnity / min / max are Update 3's values and stay valid (same names, pivots and ranges); part.box: the grab / hit box of a moving part in its own frame
meta.hierarchy: BaseMain (exterior) > R_<Room> x15, IX_* (131), FX_* (64); BaseMain_Opening (its own prefab, same place) > its 8 IX parts. Glass, signs, lenses, screens and LEDs are joined into their objects as extra materials
meta.colliders: as Update 3: a MeshCollider on every mesh object (static ones and the IX parts, glass included); no separate boxes
meta.light_layers: lightMask per part = 1 << layer of its room (Exterior 1 -> 2); BaseMain_Opening 160 (Heizung + Flur_UG), IX_MainDoorBar_311 128 (Windfang), as Update 3; prefabLights / prefabGlows are Update 3's, unchanged (the fixtures stand where they stood)
meta.materials: M_Main_Ext / M_Main_Roof (on BaseMain) / M_Main_Rm_<Room> / M_Main_Parts (+ the fixtures) / M_Main_Opening: baked PSX atlases (point filter, no mips); M_Main_Panel: signs, labels, papers, dials (+ emission map: the exit pictogram, the lenses); named materials kept from Update 3 (the game swaps or knows them): M_ScreenOff (screens, -> M_ScreenOn with power), M_LEDOff (-> M_LEDOn), M_HeatFault (the STOERUNG lamp and the reset button, -> M_HeatFaultOn), the fixtures' M_FX_Tube / Globe / Diffuser / Bulb / Exit / EmergencyLens / Halogen / Red and M_LEDOn, M_GlassClear, M_GlassDark - their definitions stay those of Forest_Materials.json
meta.sockets: knock: a point on the outside of each shutter / window / exterior door (scares X06 / X07); hand: door handles on both faces; audio: plant noises
meta.kit_instances: KPP v2.1: the Leitstand's right workstation is the base's gate station - empties Leit_* instancing snow_kit collections linked from ../snow_kit/snow_kit.blend (props kit_item, ix_ids: the IX_ part of that instance gets the number, IX_ConsoleButton -> IX_ConsoleButton_319); in the FBX only the empties - the Unity builder puts the kit prefab (Assets/Kit/Prefabs/<kit_item>) on each with its transform (pos / rot_quat_wxyz / scale in the parent's frame, *Unity in Unity axes) and the room's lightMask; the monitors show the KPP's cameras (camera.socket in kpp_contract.json)
